title: Grug Discovers Verticality
prompt: A full-60-fps construction-paper sidewalk clip. Horizontal travel and parallax remain continuous while Grug loops rapidly up and down five times per second, preserving cue-driven SAPI mouth performance.

beats.narration: Correction. Grug is still moving at sixty frames per second. Grug just goes up and down five times per second, like a piece of construction paper with a job.
beats.caption: 60 FPS REMAINS IN EFFECT · GRUG MOVES VERTICALLY

beats.narration: Horizontal motion remains smooth. The legs are decorative. The mouth is doing most of the acting.
beats.caption: LEGS: DECORATIVE · MOUTH: CARRYING THE PRODUCTION
